selection_reasons: native username identifier matches Campus login model
managed password store removes Campus plaintext verifier ownership
Pro MFA is included in Essentials
TOTP is supported as an independent MFA factor
basic attack protection is provided by the IdP
password policy can require length without forced composition
separate development and production environments are included
preferred_provider.excluded_capability: Custom Database Connections / automatic legacy-store login migration
preferred_provider.excluded_reason: requires Professional pricing observed at USD 240/month for 500 MAU; transition is finite and will be tested with an explicit migration bridge instead

strengths: first 50000 tier-1 MAU at zero platform charge
fallbacks.blocking_fit_issue: password authentication is email-centric and TOTP MFA requires verified email while only 1 of 18 active USUARIOS rows currently has an email-like value
would make Campus responsible for KDF, credential store, secrets, abuse controls, MFA, recovery and incident response

steady_state.preferred_poc_token_validation: OIDC/UserInfo remote validation rather than custom JWT cryptography in Apps Script

mfa.target_population: staff roles with internal-data or write access

new_accounts.target: do not persist password in PROSPECTOS, DATOS or USUARIOS
new_accounts.activation: one-time account-establishment flow creates IdP credential and stores only identity mapping

required_poc_evidence: TOTP staff enrollment and sign-in work
OIDC identity can be validated by Apps Script QA and mapped to a local Campus account
inactive/wrong-role local account remains denied after valid IdP authentication
one fictitious legacy account migrates and loses plaintext safely
rollback before migration commit and recovery after migration are demonstrated
actual tenant pricing/limits fit expected MAU
